title: ExperimentSpec
description: Specification of a quantum experiment (planned configuration before execution)

schema_version.description: Schema version for compatibility across the suite

experiment_id.description: Unique identifier for this experiment specification

n_qubits.description: Number of qubits used in the experiment (>=2 for entangled states)

shots.description: Number of measurement shots to run

noise_model.description: Noise model applied to the circuit (null = ideal/no noise)

error_rate.description: Error rate parameter for the chosen noise model (if applicable)

engine_config_hash.description: Hash of simulator/hardware configuration to ensure provenance

research.description: Research context metadata describing the purpose of the experiment

phase.description: Research phase or study type this experiment belongs to

hypothesis.description: Optional free-text description of the hypothesis being tested

notes.description: Additional notes or contextual remarks about the experiment
